scope: 9:16 social export only, replacement for accepted 04-office

params.prompt:
VISUAL CONTINUITY BIBLE:

This film belongs to the same continuous cinematic universe.

The digital office is the Mokaid AI Office shown in the reference image:
a premium stylized 3D office environment, slightly isometric but fully volumetric,
dark charcoal architecture, sophisticated violet and electric blue neon floor lighting,
warm amber practical lights, elegant desks, screens, plants, meeting room, coffee area,
lounge area and foosball table.

Keep the exact same architecture, furniture language, lighting palette and spatial identity
throughout every shot.

The AI employees are friendly premium stylized humanoid digital workers.
They are not metallic robots and not cartoon characters.
They look intelligent, approachable, professional and slightly futuristic.
Consistent character design throughout the film.

Cinematic physically plausible camera movement.
Premium global illumination.
Soft volumetric light.
Realistic depth of field.
Subtle motion blur.
High-end commercial cinematography.
No chaotic camera movement.
No sudden geometry changes.
No morphing furniture.
No disappearing characters.
No duplicated characters.
No warped screens.
No text generated inside screens unless specifically requested.

Every shot must feel like the camera is physically travelling through one continuous place.
Smooth acceleration and deceleration.
Elegant ease-in and ease-out camera curves.
No hard cuts unless explicitly requested.

CAMERA MOTION LANGUAGE:
The camera movement must feel designed for interactive website scrollytelling.
Every major movement follows cinematic easing curves:
stillness → gradual acceleration → fluid travel → gradual deceleration → stillness.
No constant-speed robotic camera movement.
Create natural visual resting points where the website can pause the video during scrolling.
Use strong foreground parallax when travelling through the office.
Occasionally pass close to desks, plants, chairs and characters to reinforce depth and immersion.
Movement should feel like a premium interactive experience,
somewhere between an Apple product film, a Pixar environment exploration
and a high-end architectural camera tour.
No shaky camera. No handheld movement. No whip pans. No random zooms. No hard transitions.


SHOT 04 — PORTRAIT OFFICE EXPLORATION, ONE CONTINUOUS 12-SECOND TAKE.
Strictly 9:16 vertical composition. Use the supplied start image as the exact first frame and supplied end image as the exact last frame. Preserve these two poses, camera angles, architecture and lighting at the endpoints for seamless edits into adjacent shots.

Continue from the same Mokaid office. The violet overshirt male employee visible behind the ivory-knit woman is the main subject. He completes a small interaction at his workstation, naturally stands, and walks toward the electric-blue illuminated meeting room. The camera makes a smooth, physically plausible short forward and rightward tracking move to follow him. Keep his recognizable face and head fully inside the portrait frame throughout his movement, with comfortable headroom. Keep the main subject near the central vertical axis while allowing the camera to finish at the exact supplied end-frame composition.

0–2 seconds: gently leave the supplied starting composition, with the ivory-knit woman calmly typing in the foreground.
2–5 seconds: follow the violet overshirt employee as he naturally rises from the same workstation.
5–10 seconds: smoothly track his short walk between desks toward the blue meeting room, with subtle foreground parallax from furniture and plants. Other employees stay naturally seated, continuing to type.
10–12 seconds: slow down into the exact supplied end composition, with the violet employee near the meeting room and the amber-sweater employee in the lower foreground.

The dramatic purpose is an active office, not empty furniture. The main worker must remain legible in this narrow frame throughout the middle of the shot. Do not crop off his face, do not drift into an empty corridor. Maintain the same charcoal furniture, violet floor paths, electric-blue room border and warm amber desk lamps. Preserve each person's face, hair, clothes and body proportions. Natural feet contact with the floor, coherent chair and desk positions. No teleporting, duplicated workers, furniture changes, disappearing body parts, or camera cuts. No readable screen text, subtitles, logos or overlays.

CAMERA: one elegant stabilized travelling, restrained acceleration and deceleration, smooth ease-in/ease-out, normal human eye-level perspective, no abrupt reframing, no zoom jumps, no orbit around the face.

SOUND: quiet office keyboards, soft chair movement and subtle footfalls, low office room tone. No intelligible dialogue, no voiceover, no music.

qa.method: Visual inspection with view_image of 13 sampled frames (each integer second from0 to12) plus paired endpoint references; no claim of exhaustive frame-by-frame or audio validation.
observations: The violet overshirt worker stays clearly visible during the stand and walk, including the previously weak middle section.
His complete head stays inside the portrait frame in all13 inspected frames; as he walks away, the back of his head replaces the side profile naturally.
Charcoal desks, violet pathways, blue meeting room border and amber lighting remain coherent across inspected samples.
No disappearing or duplicated principal character, abrupt cut, or obvious furniture mutation is visible in these samples.
Generated first and last frames match their supplied portrait reference compositions closely.

start.note: Compression/model variation; visual side-by-side also inspected.

end.note: Compression/model variation; visual side-by-side also inspected.

limitations: This is sampled visual review and does not certify all intermediate frames or detailed finger anatomy.
An audio stream exists; speech, sound quality and audio transitions were not listened to or verified.
